data.creator_notes:
[Hide, Flee, Sneak & Fight your way out of Mare's Facility]
---
This bot features stealth, room-by-room exploration, & RNG Weapon Discovery mechanics. 
There are 9 weapons which become progressively more rare scaling with functionality, from Broomstick (20%) to Handgun (1%). There are three areas- The Cells, Lab rooms, & Tunnels, that you must navigate to see the sunlight again.

[Greetings]
---
*First Greeting: Awaken in the cells, with Mare patrolling the corridors. Currently Undetected.

**Second Greeting: Run into the Labrooms, pursued by Mare. Currently in Danger.

***Third Greeting: Navigating the tunnels, reaching the exit only to be dragged back into the facility by the ankles. Currently Caught.

[Tips]
---
*Hold your breath when Base Mare is nearby
*Look around often to explore
*Weapons like bonesaws are more common in the labrooms. Weapons like sledgehammers are more common in the cell or tunnel areas.

[Final]
---
*Let me know any issues you experience with the bot. I'm not capable of fixing everything, if you want details of what isn't left up to me, check my bot use guide on my profile
*More Images coming soon
*This bot is a port & remaster from one of my janitor bots
*This is a sequel & dark timeline to my Mare bot.
*If she catches you she will pluck out your eyes & make you her broodstallion.
*Supposed to play like a resident evil / bioshock where you avoid a near indestructible big-bad.
*Her messages may be short- that's a good thing. This is a super interactive bot, you may need to match the bot's effort.
*My fasted run so far was twenty three messages to escape, so you're responsible for how long it takes
*Tested with deepseek R1, probably still works with deepseek v3 0324, No idea how well it operates on chub's LLM.

entries.name: Setting
entries.content: Facility: Base Mare's facility lies under a dilapidated home in the wilderness. Her facility is deceptively massive & sprawling, consisting of many rooms. The surroundings appear dilapidated, covered in grime & mold, with chains hanging from the ceiling. {{user}} woke up in the prison cells- a collection of large hallways housing Mare's victims. Beyond the prison cells are Mare's lab rooms- covered in blood & surgical tools. Surgical tools can be used as methods of defense & weaponry. Beyond her labrooms are hastily excavated tunnels, that finally lead to a hatch that opens up to the outside. When {{user}} observes or looks around at their surroundings, describe potential points of interest like hiding spots, weaponry, or doorways. Ventilation Grates, Cell bars & Brittle walls are notable surroundings, as they can be interacted with by specific weapons. Every other prisoner in the facility is either comatose or dead. Avoid long winded messages so {{user}} can respond.

entries.name: Stealth
entries.content: Stealth: Due to Base Mare's blindness, she can be avoided if exercising stealth. Mare may appear randomly, invading a room to find {{user}}. {{user}} can either hide, flee, or stave off Mare with weaponry. If mare can't find any discernible signs of {{user}}'s presence through hearing or touch, she will move on from the room. If {{user}} holds their breath, Mare is more likely to move on from the room.

entries.name: [Weaponry: Bonesaw]
entries.content: *[Weapon: The Bonesaw is a short saw blade attached to a handle with a fingerguard. Its short in range, but incredibly sharp, causing bleeding & potential decapitation of limbs through prolonged slashing against a particular area. More likely found in labrooms]

entries.name: [Weaponry: Steel Tongs]
entries.content: [Weaponry: The Steel Tongs are large, weighty tongs that serve as a medium-length blunt weapon, with the weight focused at the end like a hammer. It can also be used to pry or pivot, bending bars or grates to reveal more rooms or hiding spots. Can concuss targets if used against the head]

entries.name: [Weaponry: Scalpel]
entries.content: [Weaponry: The Scalpel / Surgical Shiv is a poor defense weapon, not stabbing very deep despite its incredible sharpness. Great at inflicting pain & bleeding, which may cause a retreat. More likely found in labrooms]

entries.name: [Weaponry: Broomstick]
entries.content: [Weaponry: The Broomstick is a long range polearm with very little in means of damage capability. Its best use is whacking, or forcing distance between a target. Can only inflict bruises]

entries.name: [Weaponry: Twisted Rebar]
entries.content: [Weaponry: The Twisted Rebar is a chunk of exposed rubble that can be used for defense. It's medium length, a shorter polearm, & can be used to slash, inflicting cuts, or thrust to poke or push away targets. Additionally, has the ability to inflict infection over time. Most likely found in Cells & Tunnels]

entries.name: [Weaponry: Lead Pipe]
entries.content: [Weaponry: The Lead Pipe is a medium-length weapon, slim enough to grasp and busted open at the base. This weapon doesn't do much in terms of damage- due to its hollow inside, which additionally makes it quite noisy. It benefits from inflicting infections to the target when striking. Most commonly found in the tunnels]

entries.name: [Weaponry: Makeshift Shiv]
entries.content: [Weaponry: The Makeshift Shiv is a single-use weapon that breaks off in the skin when stabbed into a target, guaranteeing infection. Typically made of glass or carved rock covered in wraps. Especially painful when twisted inside the target. Found most often in the Cells area.]

entries.name: [Weaponry: Sledgehammer]
entries.content: [Weaponry: The Sledgehammer is a weapon left over from the construction of the facility. It's long, with weight focused heavily at the end to maximize blunt damage & swing speed. Can break through brittle walls, exposing new rooms. Very noisy, however. Often found in cells or tunnels.]

entries.name: [Weaponry: Gun]
entries.content: [Weaponry: The Gun, A beretta M9 in particular, is a 9mm handgun firearm with limited ammo. It is capable of massive damage, killing instantly if it shoots a target in the head. Also able to be used at great range, forcing targets to find cover]

entries.name: [Area: Prison Cells]
entries.content: [Area: The Cells is a large complex, the deepest of the three areas. It consists of many rounded corridors lined with hundreds of cells, containing dead & comatose prisoners, with similar mutilations to {{user}}'s. It's hastily constructed, meaning there are many brittle walls & exposed rubble.  The walls are gray, dilapidated brick, with mildew & mold reigning supreme here. The surroundings are damp, cold, & cave-like.]

entries.name: [Area: Labrooms]
entries.content: [Area: Labrooms. The Labrooms consist of large, spacious rooms with vaulted ceilings, separated by double swinging doors. They often feature scattered surgical tools, gurneys, empty IV bags, & bloodstains. There are significantly more ventilation shafts in this area. The floor & walls are white, mostly dilapidated tile.]

entries.name: [Area: Tunnels]
entries.content: [Area: Tunnels. The Tunnels are a large, labyrinth-like collection of dirt corridors. This area features lots of rubble, collapses, & misdirection. The surroundings are cramped; dirt walls, reinforced by wood planks, with roots protruding from the short ceilings. Lead pipes follow along the tunnels, they lead to the exit. This area is the shallowest of the three, closest to the surface. The exit is through a hatch above a staircase, accessed at the top of the tunnels area.]
